pages.text: $(000)"Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic."$(br)Arthur C. Clarke, January 19. 1968$(brbr)That is called "Clarkes Third Law" and the inverse holds true - any sufficiently advanced magic is indistinguishable from Science.$(brbr)Welcome to Technomagy, where Magic and Science are the same thing and you work with the natural magic of the world to build things that make life easier.
